SIX CONTRACTS · ONE WINTER NIGHT

SILENTNIGHT

A Christmas assassin stalks the snow.
Every target has a name. Every name has a price.

FIELD MANUAL

Move with WASD. Sprint with Shift, crouch with C. Press 1, 2, 3 for knife, pistol, sniper; R reloads and right mouse aims. Complete every objective before eliminating the target — a premature kill voids the contract. Take the target from behind or the side with the knife; firearms are loud and bring every guard. In the city, press E to talk to bystanders and watch for moving traffic. If a bodyguard sees you kill, he will radio the boss and the target will run.

Headphones recommended · Desktop keyboard & mouse · Progress saved locally
